chunks: I praise Him out of gratefulness for His reward, and I seek His assistance in fulfilling His rights. He has a strong army. His dignity is grand.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the opening supplication in Nahj al-Balagha regarding gratitude and divine assistance?
ai.summary: This opening invocation from Imam Ali’s supplications in *Du'a al-Faraj* establishes the theological foundation of gratitude (*shukr*) as a prerequisite for seeking divine assistance (*isti'anah*) in fulfilling religious obligations. It reflects the Shia emphasis on recognizing Allah’s attributes of power (*Aziz*) and glory (*Azeem*) as the source of strength for the believer’s spiritual journey.
